signature.name: VTask.bind
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> [Lattice α] -> [OrderBot α] -> [IsModularLattice α] -> [DecidableEq α] -> {a : α} -> (P : Finpartition a) -> (Q : (i : α) → i ∈ P.parts → Finpartition i) -> Finpartition a

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: all inputs are fully constrained to be genuine Finpartition values; the output is always a well-formed Finpartition and no junk-value convention is needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α] [DecidableEq α] {a b : α} (P : Finpartition a) (Q : ∀ i, i ∈ P.parts → Finpartition i), b ∈ (VTask.bind P Q).parts ↔ ∃ A hA, b ∈ (Q A hA).parts

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α] [DecidableEq α] {a : α} (P : Finpartition a) (Q : ∀ i, i ∈ P.parts → Finpartition i), (VTask.bind P Q).parts.card = ∑ A ∈ P.parts.attach, (Q _ A.2).parts.card

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α] [DecidableEq α] {a b : α} (P : Finpartition a) (Q : ∀ i, i ∈ P.parts → Finpartition i) (A : α) (hA : A ∈ P.parts), b ∈ (Q A hA).parts → b ∈ (VTask.bind P Q).parts

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [Lattice α] [OrderBot α] [IsModularLattice α] [DecidableEq α] {a : α} (P : Finpartition a) (Q : ∀ i, i ∈ P.parts → Finpartition i), P.parts.card = 2 → (∀ i hi, (Q i hi).parts.card = 3) → (VTask.bind P Q).parts.card = 6
